audit_items.proof_trace: Within accrue_interest, cash_reserve is modified exclusively at line 143 via self.cash_reserve = self.cash_reserve.add(reserve_factor.mul(interest_accumulated)). Both reserve_factor and interest_accumulated are Decimal (u256-backed, always non-negative), and add() on Decimal returns a.value + b.value which is always >= a; the property cash_reserve_after >= cash_reserve_before is therefore guaranteed by construction. Edge cases where reserve_factor=0, debt=0, or interest_rate=0 result in interest_accumulated=0 and cash_reserve unchanged, still satisfying the >= condition.
